newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK to tender 5-yr 6.55 pct govt notes on March 17.
newsitem.headline: HK to tender 5-yr 6.55 pct govt notes on March 17.

text.p: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said on Monday it will tender its eleventh issue of five-year Exchange Fund Notes on March 17.
The HK$500 million notes carry a coupon of 6.55 percent per annum, with interest payable semi-annually in arrears.
The notes will mature on March 18, 2002.
An additional HK$100 million will be held as reserves by the HKMA for supply to market makers in the secondary market.
Settlement will take place on March 18, 1997, the HKMA said.
